text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Time came back.** Reps cut post-call admin from about 25 minutes to under 10. That meant more selling time, not just tidier CRM records.

**2. Quality beat quantity.** Summaries captured next steps and objections more consistently than rep memory did. Managers coached from actual conversations, not recaps.

**3. Trust took work.** Some customers hesitated at first. Asking consent upfront, and explaining how data is handled, turned most hesitations into non-issues.

**4. Adoption followed champions.** Teams where one respected rep shared wins early adopted faster than those with a top-down mandate.

The tool didn't replace judgment. It freed reps to use more of it.

What has your team learned from AI pilots?
